name: Renee Graves
source:
Renee is the wife of [url=/c138357]Douglas Graves[/url] and mother of [url=/c124925]Andrew Graves[/url] and [url=/c124924]Ashley Graves[/url]. She is first seen in a flashback in Episode 1, and officially appears in the game by Episode 2.
